name: dev.somebodybuildthis/ideas
title: Somebody Build This
description: Find an idea to build. A free public board of things people wish existed, each with a weekend plan.

tools.name: list_open_ideas
tools.description: List open ideas on Somebody Build This, a free public board where anyone posts something they wish existed and builders make it. Each idea has a ticket number, title, link, a one-sentence goal for a first weekend version, tags, and how many builds are in progress and shipped. Newest first. Ideas never lock: anyone can build any idea, even one someone else is building. Builders ship by pressing "Ship it" on the idea's page and pasting a link. Use get_brief for one idea's full text and suggested plan.

tag.description: Only ideas with this tag, like "home" or "for-kids".

limit.description: How many ideas to return (default 20, at most 50).

tools.name: get_brief
tools.description: Get one idea from Somebody Build This: the poster's own words, then a builder brief (a suggested weekend plan written by the site's AI steward, not by the person who posted the idea), a prompt for an AI coding tool, and how to ship. Pass the idea's slug (the last part of its URL, like "42-scale-reader") or its ticket number (like 42 or "#0042"). Ideas never lock; when it works, ship it by pressing "Ship it" on the idea page and pasting the link.

slug.description: The idea's slug ("42-scale-reader") or ticket number (42 or "#0042").
